error.message: run prompt is declared in surface v1 and this build has no executor for it. The request was well formed; retrying will not help until the capability lands.
"run.nonsense" is not a message type in surface v1. The type is the CLI path with dots: `run why` is `run.why`.

run.prompt does not take ifseq. It takes: if_seq, on_busy, run, text, to. Unknown parameters are refused rather than ignored: a misspelled guard (if_seq, budget) that is silently dropped makes a request the client believed was safe unsafe, and the log records it as intended
